purpose: Source-verified BE integration handoff. P15 reads existing owner results; it never owns a business command. This file is not deployment evidence or an activation switch.

operation_identity.P04_P03: requestId in the URL is the original command Idempotency-Key UUID, not the current HTTP trace. Compare request_id, draft document_id, scan_session_id, warehouse_id, operation and command in both data and receipt. Compare receipt.version with the original successful command, not automatically with the current document version.
operation_identity.P05_SOURCE_LINKED: Require caller evidence for the source-linked mode and the original source_document_id. A generic OUTBOUND draft alone does not prove P05 linkage. After RECORD, compare the owner's business_document_id with the original selected source; never create a replacement on mismatch.
operation_identity.P07: Send the exact original PATCH Idempotency-Key. Compare nested confirmation actor_id, auth_session_id, warehouse_id, item_id and physical_code_id with the caller's known identity; compare hardware_uid in the original response when known. The current GET trace is not the original PATCH trace, and P07 does not echo the key as a receipt request ID.

trace.rule: New UUID per HTTP read; keep separate from the stable operation_key. Preserve original trace only as correlation evidence.

forbidden_substitutions: latest receipt for the requested command
current mapping or events for an operation receipt

request_rules.P04_operation_query: Do not send operation; P04 supplies INBOUND internally and rejects unknown fields.
request_rules.If-Match: Do not copy a write If-Match header onto reconciliation. Owner draft detail may optionally check If-Match; a 412 means a version conflict, not operation failure.
request_rules.retry: P15 never replays writes. Native SAME_REQUEST_ONLY and SAME_KEY_SAME_PAYLOAD_ONLY_AFTER_RECONCILIATION remain owner policies, not permission for P15 to write.
request_rules.current_reads: Read only a known immutable UUID from the verified caller or a validated owner response; never auto-select or search by a displayed number. Current reads do not resolve a missing operation receipt.

blocked_cases.reason: No approved P15 recovery identity/owner contract; do not route into P04 SCOPED.
P03 OUTBOUND reconciliation in this integration is SOURCE_LINKED only.
Requires owner schema and evidence. Do not infer from DRAFT, null, 404, elapsed time or 5xx.
No approved cross-session recovery/retention policy; never rebind using only the same actor and warehouse.
Do not prepare, release, link or write from P15; require the P07 owner and its existing gates.

session.refresh: P01 auth lifecycle preserves stable session; revalidate through the owner. P15 does not create or refresh sessions itself.
session.new_login: New auth session; drop late responses, do not reuse the old session as current or rebind its receipts.
session.retention: PENDING_OWNER_POLICY; no retention duration is invented.

errors.401: Hand off to P01; do not turn session expiry into business failure.
errors.403: Only a trusted owner JSON error supports a business permission explanation; HTML/edge/proxy 403 remains unclassified transport error.
errors.409: Preserve identity/context/state conflict codes; do not retry a write.
errors.412: STALE_VERSION is separate from request outcome.
errors.422_428: Validation/precondition errors remain distinct and preserve the owner code.
errors.5xx_timeout_malformed: No definitive operation outcome. Preserve caller UNKNOWN and lock writes; no receipt/success fixture.
errors.unknown_native_outcome: Do not coerce to SUCCEEDED, FAILED or NOT_RECORDED; require owner schema review.

support.future_configuration: Owner must approve channel type/label/value/URL allowlist/scope. No fallback phone, email or endpoint.

requirements: Android NFC normal permission is not an invented runtime permission API
actual disabled/unsupported/readback states require device evidence
contact or hardware side effects require an explicit click at the correct owner

ui_acceptance_pending: one GET for a double-click while checking
drop stale response by caller generation and auth session
reauth never reuses the old session
no automatic contact, camera or NFC action
release_evidence_required: approved case-specific definitive/reauth policy where needed
owner schema/migration state without running migrations just for evidence
authenticated live GET request with trace and timestamp
redacted raw response without tokens or PII
evidence_exclusions: health check is not authenticated smoke
owner CI is not live evidence
software bridge is not hardware PASS
this contract does not approve P17 reconciliation endpoints
